english.title: In charge of a vehicle and fail to allow specimen of blood taken while incapable of giving consent to be analysed
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been informed that a specimen of blood had been taken from you under section 7A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 at a time when you were incapable of consenting to its taking, failed, without reasonable excuse, to give your permission for a laboratory test of that specimen
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7A(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:

(ii) If donor is suspected of driving or attempting to drive a vehicle then H10974 should be used

other.penalty:
Fifty one weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Discretionary disqualification. (Licence endorsed ten points).

Until the commencement of section 280(2) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003, sentencing shall have effect as if the reference to 'Fifty one weeks' were a reference to three months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
